scene: [A poor miller's cottage. Sparse furnishings. The signs of poverty are everywhere.]
caption: "There was once upon a time a poor miller who had a very beautiful daughter."

scene: [The miller's daughter. She is very beautiful.]
caption: [A beautiful young woman stands in the cottage.]

scene: [The royal palace. A grand hall with a throne at the far end.]
caption: [The miller has come to the palace for an audience with the King.]

scene: [The King sits on his throne. The miller stands before him.]
action: The miller speaks to the King.
caption: "Now it happened one day that he had an audience with the King"

scene: [The miller stands proudly before the King. He wants to appear important.]
caption: "In order to appear a person of some importance he told him that he had a daughter who could spin straw into gold."

scene: [The King leans forward on his throne. He is intrigued.]
caption: "'Now that's a talent worth having,' said the King to the miller."

scene: [The King speaks from his throne. He gives a command.]
caption: "'If your daughter is as clever as you say, bring her to my palace to-morrow, and I'll put her to the test.'"

scene: [The palace hallway. Guards escort a young woman toward the throne room.]
action: The guards lead the girl through the hallway.
caption: [The miller's daughter is brought to the palace.]

scene: [The King stands before the miller's daughter in the palace.]
caption: "When the girl was brought to him he led her into a room full of straw"

scene: [The King leads the girl down a corridor. They approach a heavy door.]
caption: [He led her into a room full of straw.]

scene: [A room filled floor to ceiling with straw. A spinning-wheel and spindle sit in the corner.]
caption: [A room full of straw. A spinning-wheel and spindle wait.]

scene: [The King holds a spinning-wheel and spindle. He gives them to the girl.]
action: The King gives her the spinning-wheel and spindle.
caption: "Gave her a spinning-wheel and spindle."

scene: [The King stands at the doorway. He speaks to the girl inside.]
caption: "'Now set to work and spin all night till early dawn.'"

scene: [The King's face is stern. He delivers his threat.]
caption: "'And if by that time you haven't spun the straw into gold you shall die.'"

scene: [The King closes the heavy door. The girl watches from inside.]
caption: "Then he closed the door behind him and left her alone inside."

scene: [The girl stands alone in the straw room. The door is shut. She is trapped.]
caption: [She is alone in the room full of straw.]

scene: [The girl sits down among the straw. She does not know what to do.]
caption: "So the poor miller's daughter sat down, and didn't know what in the world she was to do."

scene: [The girl looks at the straw. She has no idea how to spin it into gold.]
caption: "She hadn't the least idea of how to spin straw into gold"

scene: [The girl's face fills with misery. Tears begin to form.]
caption: [She becomes miserable.]

scene: [The girl cries in the straw room. Her tears fall on the straw.]
caption: "And became at last so miserable that she began to cry."

scene: [The door of the straw room. It begins to open.]
caption: [The door opens.]

scene: [A tiny little man steps through the doorway. He is small and strange.]
caption: "Suddenly the door opened, and in stepped a tiny little man"

scene: [The tiny man stands before the crying girl. He looks at her.]
caption: "'Good-evening, Miss Miller-maid; why are you crying so bitterly?'"

scene: [The girl looks up at the tiny man. She answers him.]
caption: "'I have to spin straw into gold, and haven't a notion how it's done.'"

scene: [The tiny man asks the girl a question. The spinning-wheel is visible behind them.]
caption: "'What will you give me if I spin it for you?'"

scene: [The girl reaches for her necklace. She offers it to the tiny man.]
caption: "'My necklace,' replied the girl."

scene: [The tiny man takes the necklace from her hands.]
caption: "The little man took the necklace,"

scene: [The tiny man sits down at the spinning-wheel.]
caption: "sat himself down at the wheel"

scene: [The tiny man begins to spin. The wheel turns.]
caption: "and whir, whir, whir, the wheel went round three times,"

scene: [The bobbin is full of gold. The tiny man stops spinning.]
caption: "and the bobbin was full."

scene: [The tiny man puts on another empty bobbin.]
caption: "Then he put on another"

scene: [The wheel turns again. The tiny man spins.]
caption: "and whir, whir, whir, the wheel went round three times, and the second too was full"

scene: [The tiny man continues spinning through the night. Bobbin after bobbin fills with gold.]
caption: "And so it went on till the morning, when all the straw was spun away"

scene: [Morning light streams through the window. All the bobbins are full of gold. The straw is gone.]
caption: "and all the bobbins were full of gold."

scene: [The sun rises. Light fills the straw room. Gold glitters on the bobbins.]
caption: [The sun rises over the room of gold.]

scene: [The King opens the door. He sees the gold.]
caption: "As soon as the sun rose the King came"

scene: [The King stares at the bobbins of gold. His eyes widen.]
caption: "and when he perceived the gold he was astonished and delighted"

scene: [The King's face shows greed. He wants more gold.]
caption: "but his heart only lusted more than ever after the precious metal."

scene: [The King leads the girl down a corridor. They approach a second, larger room.]
caption: "He had the miller's daughter put into another room full of straw, much bigger than the first"

scene: [A second room, much larger than the first, filled with straw. The girl stands inside.]
caption: [A second room, much bigger than the first, full of straw.]

scene: [The King speaks to the girl from the doorway. He gives his command.]
caption: "and bade her, if she valued her life, spin it all into gold before the following morning."

scene: [The girl is alone in the second straw room. She does not know what to do.]
caption: "The girl didn't know what to do"

scene: [The girl begins to cry again.]
caption: "and began to cry."

scene: [The door opens. The tiny little man appears again.]
caption: "Then the door opened as before, and the tiny little man appeared"

scene: [The tiny man asks the girl his question.]
caption: "'What'll you give me if I spin the straw into gold for you?'"

scene: [The girl pulls the ring from her finger. She holds it out to him.]
caption: "'The ring from my finger,' answered the girl."

scene: [The tiny man takes the ring from her hand.]
caption: "The manikin took the ring,"

scene: [The tiny man sits at the spinning-wheel. He begins to spin.]
caption: "and whir! round went the spinning-wheel again"

scene: [Morning light fills the room. All the straw has been spun into gold.]
caption: "and when morning broke he had spun all the straw into glittering gold."

scene: [The King enters the room. He sees the gold. He is pleased.]
caption: "The King was pleased beyond measure at the sight."

scene: [The King's face shows insatiable greed. The gold is not enough.]
caption: "But his greed for gold was still not satisfied."

scene: [The King leads the girl to a third room. It is the biggest yet, filled with straw.]
caption: "and he had the miller's daughter brought into a yet bigger room full of straw"

scene: [The third room. Enormous. Straw fills every corner. The girl stands small in the middle.]
caption: [The third room. The biggest yet. Full of straw.]

scene: [The King speaks to the girl. He makes his offer.]
caption: "'You must spin all this away in the night'"

scene: [The King continues speaking. He promises her something.]
caption: "'But if you succeed this time you shall become my wife.'"

scene: [The King thinks to himself. He considers her as a wife.]
caption: "'She's only a miller's daughter, it's true,' he thought"

scene: [The King continues thinking. He could not find a richer wife.]
caption: "'But I couldn't find a richer wife if I were to search the whole world over.'"

scene: [The girl is alone in the third straw room. The door is closed.]
caption: "When the girl was alone the little man appeared for the third time"

scene: [The tiny man appears for the third time. He stands before the girl.]
caption: [The tiny man appears for the third time.]

scene: [The tiny man asks the girl his question.]
caption: "'What'll you give me if I spin the straw for you once again?'"

scene: [The girl answers. She has nothing left to give.]
caption: "'I've nothing more to give,' answered the girl."

scene: [The tiny man makes his demand. He wants her firstborn child.]
caption: "'Then promise me when you are Queen to give me your first child.'"

scene: [The girl thinks to herself. She considers her situation.]
caption: "'Who knows what may not happen before that?' thought the miller's daughter"

scene: [The girl sees no other way out. She is trapped.]
caption: "and besides, she saw no other way out of it"

scene: [The girl promises the tiny man. She gives her word.]
caption: "so she promised the manikin what he demanded"

scene: [The tiny man sits at the spinning-wheel. He begins to spin for the third time.]
caption: "and he set to work once more and spun the straw into gold."

scene: [Morning. The King enters the third straw room. Gold fills the room.]
caption: "When the King came in the morning"

scene: [The King looks at the gold. Everything is as he desired.]
caption: "and found everything as he had desired"

scene: [The King speaks to the miller's daughter. He makes her his wife.]
caption: "he straightway made her his wife"

scene: [The miller's daughter wears a crown. She is now a queen.]
caption: "and the miller's daughter became a queen."

scene: [The palace. A year passes. Seasons change outside the windows.]
caption: "When a year had passed"

scene: [A newborn baby. A beautiful son. The Queen holds him.]
caption: "a beautiful son was born to her"

scene: [The Queen gazes at her baby. She is happy. She has forgotten the tiny man.]
caption: "and she thought no more of the little man"

scene: [The Queen plays with her son. She has forgotten her promise.]
caption: [She has forgotten her promise.]

scene: [The Queen's chamber. She is alone with her baby.]
caption: [The Queen is alone with her baby.]

scene: [The door opens. The tiny little man steps into the room.]
caption: "till all of a sudden one day he stepped into her room"

scene: [The tiny man stands before the Queen. He speaks.]
caption: "'Now give me what you promised.'"

scene: [The Queen's face fills with terror. She remembers her promise.]
caption: [The Queen is horrified. She remembers.]

scene: [The Queen offers the tiny man riches. She begs him.]
caption: "The Queen was in a great state, and offered the little man all the riches in her kingdom"

scene: [The Queen continues pleading. She wants him to leave the child.]
caption: "if he would only leave her the child."

scene: [The tiny man refuses. He wants the child.]
caption: "'No, a living creature is dearer to me than all the treasures in the world.'"

scene: [The Queen begins to cry.]
caption: "Then the Queen began to cry"

scene: [The Queen sobs bitterly. Her grief is deep.]
caption: "and sob so bitterly"

scene: [The tiny man watches the Queen cry. He feels sorry for her.]
caption: "that the little man was sorry for her"

scene: [The tiny man speaks. He gives her a chance.]
caption: "'I'll give you three days to guess my name'"

scene: [The tiny man finishes his offer. She must guess his name.]
caption: "'and if you find it out in that time you may keep your child.'"

scene: [Night. The Queen sits alone. She thinks of every name she has ever heard.]
caption: "Then the Queen pondered the whole night over all the names she had ever heard"

scene: [The Queen sends a messenger out into the world.]
caption: "and sent a messenger to scour the land"

scene: [The messenger rides out. He is to find names far and near.]
caption: "and to pick up far and near any names he could come across."

scene: [The next day. The tiny man arrives at the palace.]
caption: "When the little man arrived on the following day she began with Kasper, Melchior, Belshazzar"

scene: [The Queen lists all the names she knows. She speaks them one after another.]
caption: "and all the other names she knew, in a string"

scene: [The tiny man replies to each name. He denies them all.]
caption: "but at each one the manikin called out"

scene: [The tiny man speaks his reply.]
caption: "'That's not my name.'"

scene: [The second day. The Queen sends out messengers to the neighborhood.]
caption: "The next day she sent to inquire the names of all the people in the neighborhood"

scene: [The messengers return with a long list of names.]
caption: "and had a long list of the most uncommon and extraordinary for the little man"

scene: [The tiny man arrives. The Queen reads from the list.]
caption: "'Is your name, perhaps, Sheepshanks Cruickshanks, Spindleshanks?'"

scene: [The tiny man denies the names again.]
caption: "But he always replied: 'That's not my name.'"

scene: [The third day. The messenger returns to the palace.]
caption: "On the third day the messenger returned and announced"

scene: [The messenger speaks to the Queen. He has news.]
caption: "'I have not been able to find any new names'"

scene: [The messenger describes his journey. He came upon a high hill.]
caption: "'But as I came upon a high hill round the corner of the wood'"

scene: [The messenger describes what he saw. Foxes and hares. A little house.]
caption: "'Where the foxes and hares bid each other good-night, I saw a little house'"

scene: [A fire burns in front of a little house. A grotesque little man dances around it.]
caption: "'In front of the house burned a fire, and round the fire sprang the most grotesque little man, hopping on one leg'"

scene: [The tiny man dances and sings. He cries out a rhyme.]
caption: "'and crying: To-morrow I brew, to-day I bake'"

scene: [The tiny man continues his rhyme. He will take the child.]
caption: "'And then the child away I'll take; For little deems my royal dame'"

scene: [The tiny man reveals his name in the rhyme.]
caption: "'That Rumpelstiltzkin is my name!'"

scene: [The Queen hears the name. She is delighted.]
caption: "You can imagine the Queen's delight at hearing the name"

scene: [The Queen smiles. She knows his name now.]
caption: [She knows his name.]

scene: [The little man steps into the Queen's room. He asks for her answer.]
caption: "When the little man stepped in shortly afterward and asked: 'Now, my lady Queen, what's my name?'"

scene: [The Queen asks the first name. She is calm.]
caption: "'Is your name Conrad?'"

scene: [The tiny man replies.]
caption: "'No.'"

scene: [The Queen asks the second name.]
caption: "'Is your name Harry?'"

scene: [The tiny man replies again.]
caption: "'No.'"

scene: [The Queen asks the true name. She is confident.]
caption: "'Is your name perhaps, Rumpelstiltzkin?'"

scene: [The tiny man screams. His face twists with rage.]
caption: "'Some demon has told you that! some demon has told you that!'"

scene: [The tiny man drives his right foot into the ground.]
action: He drives his foot into the ground.
caption: [He drives his right foot into the ground.]

scene: [His foot sinks into the ground up to his waist.]
caption: [His foot sinks in up to his waist.]

scene: [In a passion, the tiny man seizes his left foot with both hands.]
caption: [He seizes his left foot with both hands.]

scene: [The tiny man tears himself in two.]
caption: [He tears himself in two.]

scene: [The Queen stands alone in her chamber. The tiny man is gone.]
caption: [The Queen is alone. Her child is safe.]
